text:
maria: Quick weekly run-through — regional capacity + immediate actions. TL;DR: NA looks tight for the next 72h (need short burst or reschedules), EU mostly healthy but one cluster has disk pressure, APAC has modest headroom but watch egress during promo. Posting short table and action items.

maria: ```
Region           | Current GPU-hrs/day | 7d proj peak | Headroom
--------------------------------------------------------------
NA (us-west/us-east) | 42,500            | 55,000       | -18% (shortfall)
EU (eu-central)      | 28,000            | 30,000       | +7% (OK)
APAC (ap-southeast)  | 9,500             | 12,000       | -5% (tight during promo)
Reserved pool        | 15,000            | 15,000       | 0% (reserved fully used)
```

ashok: NA detail: us-west-2-cluster-a is at 92% node utilization, queue depth rising on medium jobs. Two levers: short burst (spin 4 x A100 for 48h) or throttle lower-priority batch jobs. Pref to burst + reschedule quantization.

ashok: cost rough calc for 4 A100 nodes = ~$6k/day incremental (dedicated pool pricing). If we keep for 48h ~ $12k.

ashok: quick scale command if we go burst:
```
redwoodctl scale --cluster us-west-2-cluster-a --add 4 --gpu-type a100 --duration 48h
```

taylor: Agree with burst as emergency. Also propose moving non-urgent quantization/finetune to 02:00-06:00 PT window for next 5 days (off-peak). We can gate to dedicated nodes `quant-dedicated-01` so it doesn't compete with low-latency inference.

taylor: Action: I'll add schedule + gating rule in airflow and tag jobs `priority:low` so autoscaler deprioritizes them.

jamal: FYI last week's S3 egress spikes (apac->na cross-region pulls) caused 200-300ms tail increases for some inference routes during the morning ramp. If APAC promo runs, we should pre-stage hot models or use regional read-only model cache.

jamal: Link to logs: https://internal-redwood/logs/egress-spike-193205 (watch requests ~09:00-10:30 PT)

maria: Good catch. Temporary mitigation: pin heavy models to APAC edge cache and set fallback to eu-central if cache misses > 5%.

maria: EU note: eu-central-1-cluster-b has /dev/nvme at 88% (old logs + checkpoints). We should run the cleanup job before the weekend maintenance or risk job eviction.

infra-bot: Scheduled task created: eu-central-1-disk-cleanup at 1932160000 (expected duration 2h). Owner: @taylor. :hammer_and_wrench:

 taylor: I'll run cleanup on Friday 02:00 UTC and confirm. Will also snapshot current checkpoints first.

ashok: Two more asks:
- Can we open 10% burst quota on NA reserved pool for the next 72h? (finance briefed — they approved up to $15k/day emergency spend)
- If burst not possible, we'll enforce low-priority throttles (will drop throughput on background jobs ~30%).

maria: Finance-approved headroom noted. Decision: proceed with 4xA100 burst for 48h on us-west-2-cluster-a, pre-stage APAC hot models, and run EU cleanup. Owners:
- Burst scale: @ashok
- Quant job schedule + gating: @taylor
- APAC pre-stage + cache rules: @jamal
- EU cleanup: @taylor

maria: Quick follow-up meeting to confirm start and handoff: 30-min capacity huddle tomorrow 09:30 PT. Please bring exact node IDs, expected cost delta, and rollback plan. :calendar:

taylor: Got it — I'll post the gating PR and airflow DAG update before the meeting.

ashok: I'll queue the scale job and keep watch on autoscaler alerts. Will post `redwoodctl` output in thread when started. :eyes:

jamal: I'll pre-stage the top-5 hot models to ap-southeast cache and add a metric for cache-miss-rate > 5% -> autoswitch to eu-central.

maria: Thanks team. If anything urgent pops up before the huddle, ping me directly. :thumbsup:
